venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Tuesday 9/1.** First Bingo Tuesday of the month; a few Meal Deals to start the day. Welcomed Maddy, the new Bingo host. September sponsors are Nikka Gin & Whiskey — suggest those specials on non-Tuesdays; a Nikka Gin bottle is now in the middle well. Margarita batch nearly finished and will no longer be batched. Detailed stainless steel, ran drip decks; smooth night. Valero completed her first day of training. Kitchen: watch over-seasoning on jojos and jalapeño poppers. Comps $68.50. No 86s, no maintenance needs, no incidents. Favorite moment: meeting new Bingo host Maddy. MOD Mkz/JK. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Tuesday 9/1.** Smooth, steady Tuesday with even pacing. First guests at 4:15pm were a 7-person post-work happy hour that stayed nearly 4 hours and played bingo — a noticeable share of sales. Bingo started ~6:15pm with a core of 8–10 players for ~45 min; most closed out after, then a small pop at 10:15pm; last 2 guests left at midnight. Kitchen: John Michael consistent in the kitchen and present on the floor. Comps $78 / 6% (bingo credit, DNL, manager, F&F). Maintenance: keg cooler CO2 (possible solution in works). No incidents. Favorite moment: bingo regular Cassaundra brought her dog in again. MOD KK / JMS. Entered by BC.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tuesday 9/1.** Beat target including events. DC/AM $1,270.79; D&C PM $6,886.05; Garden/6A $2,473; net ex-events $8,156.84 vs $8,059 target; net event sales $1,710 (event food $1,515); total net incl. events $9,866.84; total food incl. events $3,511.75. AM: chill Tuesday, deep cleaned, orders in, cold brew steeping for 7am. PM: very tight floor staffing — Paige and Ryan held it alone with small waitlists and still hit the rev goal; first day of the Snacks Only 3–5pm menu went fine. Kitchen: slow weeknight, two good learning pops for Fiellah; low on olives, hot honey, fingerlings, 8oz burger portions, steaks; 911 on bunny ravioli; no 86s. Events: day 2 of Anaconda LLC meetings, 15 guests 8am–5pm in Vauxhall (to-go breakfast + lunch spread); day 3 tomorrow. Tomorrow: Air Purification Company, 26 guests 10am–4pm in Vauxhall — coffee/hot water/creamers on Vauxhall bar top by 10am. Maintenance: Garden stair left-side door won't open due to warped wood from rain (right side starting too); needs sanding — TRH/FD Jess aware. Comps $229.15. No-shows charged. No incidents. Entered by MJH.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday 9/1.** Decent Tuesday, beat target. Food $508, beverage $3,275, retail $26; net $3,809 vs $3,647. Slow start in rain, filled at 7:30pm, lull ~9:30, full reseat 10–10:15 that cleared by ~midnight. Dates, coworkers/business meetings, enthusiastic first-timers; laid-back vibe. 4 birthdays, 2 anniversaries; a couple from Texas visiting for the first time; industry: Cassandra (Diageo), Leo (Midnight Blue). One guest smuggled in a drink from Amor y Amargo. One menu stolen/lost. 102 covers, 4 solos. Best sellers: Rosalie, Native Lion, Shinebox; back-catalogue: Arrowhead Negroni. Kitchen: 86 oysters. Menu count 19/18; zero glassware breakage. No no-shows. Comps $37.78 / 0.9%. Nothing new on maintenance. MOD Kyler + Steves. Entered by MK.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: Hot but not as bad as it has been
venues.narrative: **LA — Tuesday 9/1.** Sleepy but fun night, well under target ($2,876 vs $4,258); Marquee only, Standing Room closed. Streets very quiet; never formed a waitlist; no large groups (two 4-tops, a few solos, mostly couples). Team used the slow first hours for cleaning, training and side projects. Bailey did great on the floor — wrote out cocktail recipes and gifted them in a D&C gift bag to a birthday guest. Kitchen beat its food target ($784); shoutout to Josh for prepping to get everything back on the menu and to Saleh for picking up a 6th day this week. Comps $141.65 (friends & fam, birthday, DNL). No-shows charged. No incidents. MOD Gigi & Saleh. Entered by Gigi.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Tuesday 9/1.** Crazy Tuesday — beat target. Marquee bar sales $4,506.92; total net incl. events $4,080.10 vs $3,609 target; food $630; Garden $0. Opened with a 15-top walk-in (influenza convention) that kept growing and moving; host arrived late ~5:15 and helped herd cats. Steady walk-ins, solid push 7–8:30pm; more convention groups ~10 and ~11pm. Chaz tracked everyone, Jada and Alex assisted the floor, Savannah bussed/reset. A/C stopped at one point — replaced thermostat batteries, resolved. Kitchen: big night, James ran food and paced large tickets. Guests 97 (77 walk-in / 20 resos). Comps $2 (investor). Improve: more urgency pre-shift — check/replace fuel cells and fully set garden + entrance before doors. Maintenance: garbage disposal. No-shows not charged. No incidents. MOD Marcus. Entered by Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Tuesday 9/1.** Just under target ($2,984 vs $3,016). AM $966 (25 guests), PM $1,798 (51 guests), Sun Club $219, Hot Eye $0; food $1,384. Morning: Tia trained Earl on brunch; a 13-top bachelorette reservation weeded the kitchen a bit. Evening: Sierra trained Maddie and held most of dinner; one server + bartender + barback was enough — waited for a pop that never came. Sun Club slow; Aimee's final training day, cut ~3pm; nice breeze, some action ~4pm. Kitchen: super slow, scrubbed down and nearly done by 10:15pm; no lows; caviar ordered; 86 stuffed peppers permanently. Comps $352.85. No incidents. Favorite moment: Maddie confidently leading tables with Sierra's approval. AM MOD Sam; PM Justin & Shannon. Entered by Justin.
